अरोगता f. अरो˚गत्व n., अरो˚गिता & अरो˚ग्यता f. =
prec. m.

अरोचकिन् a. having no appetite;
 critical, dainty.
अरोचमान a. not shining, not pleasing.

अरोषण a. not angry;
 meek, tender.*

आरोपण n. the same;
 the stringing of a bow.

आरोपणीय a. to be caused to mount (loc.), to be strung
(a bow), being substituted or identified.

आरोहिन् a. mounting;
 causing to rise, bringing to (—˚).
